baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II agent noun in لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ anchors the line in actively declaring a report or its bearer false.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dative construction assigns the day-specific woe to agents who do not merely hold an error but perform takdhib by rejecting or discrediting what confronts them.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the focus word's direct agentive denial and its social direction.

changed_reading.after: A day-bound woe assigned to agents who actively declare the disclosed claim or messenger false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ remains anchored in ك ذ ب, but the inventory preserves a branch in which a charge proves false by not being carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: Takdhib can be tested by performance: a declared stance becomes 'false' when it fails under the action that should fulfill it. The woe can therefore expose an enacted failure as well as false speech.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true only by being carried through supplies a performance test for the deniers' stance.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are identified only by a false verbal judgment.
changed_reading.after: The deniers may also be identified by a stance that fails when reality demands that it be carried through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's branch of a patterned cloth that deceives by its condition remains attached to مُكَذِّبِينَ as a form-distant appearance image.
baseline_models.mechanism: Falsehood need not be confined to an utterance; a displayed condition can make a false claim about itself. On this branch, the woe targets participation in an appearance that advertises what it cannot supply.

activation_trace.role: The deceptively variegated cloth supplies falsehood performed by visible condition rather than by speech alone.

changed_reading.after: Takdhib may resonate with an appearance whose displayed condition makes a false promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event moves from reported object to encountered destination. The addressees are sent without remaining held back toward what they had denied, while the earlier promise is characterized as falling and becoming fixed; مُكَذِّبِينَ now names a class overtaken by the realized referent of its own denial.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood anchors the focus verdict in the deniers' prior rejection.
The same false-attribution branch identifies the destination as precisely what the addressees used to deny.
Unimpeded departure turns denial from a position held at a distance into compelled movement toward its object.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the event's transition from promise to irreversible occurrence.

structural_cues: 77:29 makes the denied object the commanded destination; 77:30-33 disclose that destination before 77:34 repeats the refrain.
The certainty statement at 77:7 precedes the surah's repeated verdict cycle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a certain occurrence, movement toward the denied object, and the closing refrain; I infer that encounter functions as disproof of the deniers' stance. A live alternative is that the movement is punitive without carrying an evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The line threatens people who reject a future warning.
changed_reading.after: The line pronounces their denial failed after the rejected warning has become the environment they must enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scene names a shade whose defining functions of cover and sufficiency are negated, then presents fire in the visible forms of a building and huge camels. The deceptive-condition branch of ك ذ ب makes the deniers' error an investment in labels and appearances that advertise refuge while delivering flame.

activation_trace.role: A cloth that lies by its visible condition anchors an exploratory reading of denial as trust in misleading display.
Shade as protective cover supplies the function promised by the scene's label.
Sufficiency supplies the protective outcome explicitly denied to the apparent shade.
The tongue and ignition of fire expose what the shelter-like display actually contains.
The enclosed building image gives the sparks a massive shelter-like visible form.
Camel-like magnitude completes the spectacle whose apparent forms conceal its fiery function.

structural_cues: 77:30 names the shade, 77:31 negates both shade and protection, and 77:32-33 replace refuge with a sequence of similes before the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shelter label, negated shelter functions, flame, and imposing similes; I infer that this staged mismatch mirrors the focus root's deceptive-appearance branch. The live alternative is that the similes only measure terror and do not characterize the deniers' epistemic habit.

changed_reading.before: The deniers simply reject a proposition.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are also exposed as readers of false appearances, taking a displayed shelter for what its actual condition cannot provide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus clause recurs after successive demonstrations. A branch of ف ص ل supplies divisions that regulate discourse, while the day supplies a severe event-time; each refrain works as a verdict boundary that converts the preceding scene into a completed count against takdhib rather than merely repeating a threat.

activation_trace.role: The focus names the recurring judged act as declaring the disclosed truth false.
An earlier identical refrain establishes recurrence of the same false-attribution verdict across distinct units.
Divisions that regulate speech and measure supply a discourse-level function for the repeated refrain.
The severe event of the day supplies the recurrent temporal setting in which each verdict becomes operative.

structural_cues: At 77:34 the refrain closes the fire-spectacle unit and immediately precedes a new speech-and-excuse unit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence, successive scene boundaries, and a branch image of measured discourse divisions; I infer that each recurrence closes an evidentiary unit and reissues judgment. A live alternative is undifferentiated emphatic repetition.

changed_reading.before: 77:34 is an isolated curse inserted after a punishment image.
changed_reading.after: 77:34 is a calibrated verdict boundary: it seals one proof-scene against denial and resets the hearing for the next.

context_deltas.mechanism: مُكَذِّبِينَ profiles agents of prior counter-speech; immediately after the focus, speech, authorization, and excuse are successively unavailable. The refrain therefore functions as a procedural cutoff at which the practice of declaring the message false can no longer be extended by another utterance.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood anchors the condemned identity in a prior act of counter-speech.
Ordinary speech is explicitly removed, closing the channel through which denial had operated.
Permission and authorization supply the procedural gate that is not opened for further defense.
Excuse supplies the unavailable defensive speech toward which denied permission would have led.

structural_cues: 77:34 is followed immediately by two coordinated negative clauses in 77:35-36: no speaking and no permission leading to excuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-act identity followed by loss of speech, permission, and excuse; I infer a procedural transition from contestable claim to closed verdict. A live alternative is that muteness is only a separate punishment with no retrospective relation to takdhib.

changed_reading.before: Woe is a consequence attached to an earlier false claim.
changed_reading.after: Woe marks the boundary where the deniers' false-making discourse is closed and no further account can be authorized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence aligns an uttered command, refusal of bodily lowering, and absence of heart-settled assent. Against the focus root's charge-that-fails branch, takdhib becomes non-performance across word, body, and trust: the response falsifies its own adequacy by refusing to be carried through.

activation_trace.role: A charge that fails when not carried through anchors the move from verbal denial to failed performance.
An uttered command supplies the explicit claim upon the hearers' response.
Humbling submission supplies the bodily action whose repeated negation makes nonresponse visible.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the inward completion also absent at the surah's close.

structural_cues: 77:48 places saying and not bowing in one conditional scene; 77:50 closes the surah by asking what discourse could produce belief afterward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, bodily refusal, and absent settled assent; I transfer the charge's success/failure test to this response sequence. A live alternative keeps B004 in its martial idiom and reads the later refusal as moral evidence without lexical feedback into مُكَذِّبِينَ.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are people who verbally call a report false.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are also people whose body and settled trust fail to enact the response demanded by what they heard.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus citation is a pastoral idiom for milk failing expected duration, not the ordinary gloss of مُكَذِّبِينَ. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by a named shade that cannot suffice plus enjoyment explicitly curtailed as little. Render it only as a material analogy for failed expectation, never as a replacement lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب inventory's failed-milk branch permits an expectation that seems sustainable but does not last.

activation_trace.role: Milk that disappears instead of lasting anchors the material pattern of promised support failing expectation.
Protective shade supplies the expected support that the clause explicitly withholds.
Sufficiency supplies the failed functional test for the apparent shelter.
Extended continuance for enjoyment supplies the duration that the address sharply limits.
Littleness and paucity contract the apparent provision before another refrain.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib is only rejection of a report's truth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, takdhib is reliance on supports whose promised sufficiency and duration fail when needed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch 'not delaying to act' belongs to a form-distant idiom. It remains worth carrying because the packet fixes a term, commands immediate movement, and later displays refusal to lower oneself. Downstream prose should mark procrastinated response as a temporal resonance only, not derive مُكَذِّبِينَ directly from delay.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory includes an idiom in which ك ذ ب concerns whether action is delayed.

activation_trace.role: The idiom of not delaying action anchors an exploratory temporal test within the focus root.
A fixed terminal duration supplies the limit beyond which response cannot be deferred.
Movement without remaining held back supplies the compelled immediacy that replaces earlier delay.
Refusal of humbling submission supplies the delayed or withheld response made visible in action.

changed_reading.before: The deniers make an incorrect judgment about truth.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary temporal resonance, their denial is response deferred until the fixed day forces movement and removes the opportunity to yield.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequence turns the denied warning into an encountered destination, so the refrain records denial being overtaken by its referent.
Whole-surah recurrence makes 77:34 a verdict boundary that closes one evidentiary scene and opens the next.
The following loss of speech and the later refusal to bow extend takdhib from a proposition into a failed discursive and embodied response.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is an exact refrain placed between a spectacular false shelter and a shutdown of speech. Whole-surah ordering activated both a discourse-level boundary function and a visual mismatch between advertised appearance and actual effect without forcing those readings into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The failed-charge and deceptive-appearance branches may be analogical activations rather than live lexical force in مُكَذِّبِينَ.
The repeated refrain may mark discrete verdicts after each unit or cumulatively intensify one undivided judgment.
The failed-provision and deferred-response outliers depend on form-distant idioms and should remain explicitly secondary.
